dedupe_keys.name: map dataset of critical raw materials offshore occurrences and deposits of europe 2024 gseu

description: This dataset maps Critical Raw Materials occurrences and deposits in marine minerals of the European seas, based on the European Commission's 2023 CRM list. The Zenodo record says it was compiled in 2024 from national and regional geological survey contributions in the EU-funded Geological Service for Europe project, and covers cobalt-rich ferromanganese crusts, polymetallic nodules, seafloor massive sulphides and hydrothermal mineralisation, phosphorites and marine placers, sized super large to small by total resources and reserves. It was published in July 2025 by a team of geological survey authors whose first author is Egidio Marino of the Instituto Geológico y Minero de España, under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one Excel file of about 1.4 MB. Coverage is European seas. Caveats: sizes rest on preliminary studies, and the record says it is a geological assessment only that does not imply extractability or consider infrastructure or environmental conditions. For simulation it gives offshore mineral occurrence locations for seabed mining scenarios, subsea cable and pipeline conflict screening and supply studies. Related catalogue records include the GSEU hard rock CRM deposits dataset.
name: Map dataset of Critical Raw Materials offshore occurrences and deposits of Europe 2024 (GSEU)
provider: Geological survey organisations of the Geological Service for Europe (GSEU) project (first author at the Instituto Geológico y Minero de España), via Zenodo
